expectations.text: SKILL.md has valid frontmatter with name, description, and trigger phrases
expectations.evidence: quick_validate.py returns 'Skill is valid!'. Description includes 6 trigger phrases: 'run a ralph loop', 'run ralph against this repo', 'set up autonomous coding workers', 'ralph wiggum loop', 'PRD to PR with parallel workers', 'autonomous multi-worker build from PRD'.

expectations.text: SKILL.md follows progressive disclosure: frontmatter → body → linked files
expectations.evidence: Frontmatter is 3 lines with description. Body has full instructions. Linked files in references/, assets/, scripts/ are loaded on-demand.

expectations.text: Instructions follow a clear sequential step structure
expectations.evidence: Steps 1-7 flow sequentially: Initialize → Plan → Worker dispatch → Validation gates → Integration → PR + Review → Report. Non-sequential sections (Agent backends, Run management, Configuration) are placed after the steps.

expectations.text: The orchestrator correctly chains state in cmd_full
expectations.evidence: After cmd_init, cmd_full calls _load_state to find the ralph_dir and sets args.run_dir so subsequent commands find it. Lines 927-929 of ralph_orchestrator.py.

expectations.text: cmd_review uses correct PR API URLs with actual owner/repo/number values
expectations.evidence: Uses 'gh pr view --json number,url' and 'gh repo view --json nameWithOwner' to resolve actual values before building the API path. Lines 708-724 of ralph_orchestrator.py.

expectations.text: Validation gates run against the correct directory (worktree for per-worker, repo for post-merge)
expectations.evidence: run_focused_gates() runs against worker worktree path before the pass/fail decision. run_all_gates() runs against repo_dir after merge. Two-level gate architecture in cmd_run.

expectations.text: test_focused_cmd from repo_profile is used for per-worker validation
expectations.evidence: run_focused_gates() uses profile.get('test_focused_cmd', profile.get('test_cmd')) — falls back to test_cmd if focused cmd not configured.

expectations.text: Prerequisite tools are checked before running
expectations.evidence: check_prerequisites() verifies git, gh, python3, and agent-specific tools (codex+docker or opencode). Called at the start of cmd_init.

expectations.text: Worker worktrees are cleaned between rounds
expectations.evidence: reset_worktree() runs git checkout, reset --hard, and clean -fd. Called for each worker at the start of each round in cmd_run.

expectations.text: RUN_RESULT.md report includes per-task breakdown, key step durations, validation summary, and retrospective notes
expectations.evidence: cmd_report generates all template sections: Task Breakdown table, Key Step Durations with percentages, Validation Summary from gate events, Retrospective Notes (longest task, most retried, conflicts, gate failures).

SKILL.md Files section describes ralph.sh as 'standalone single-worker loop runner (for manual/debug use; orchestrator manages workers directly)'. ralph.sh header comment confirms it is NOT called by the orchestrator.

expectations.text: Cross-agent context is clear — skill can be invoked from any agent
expectations.evidence: Opening line of SKILL.md body: 'The orchestrator can be invoked from any agent (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) — it uses Codex Docker or OpenCode agent API as the worker backends.'

improvements_applied.issue: cmd_full state chaining broken — subsequent commands couldn't find state created by cmd_init
improvements_applied.fix: After cmd_init, call _load_state to resolve ralph_dir and set args.run_dir

improvements_applied.issue: cmd_review PR API URL used literal Python format braces — gh api would 404
improvements_applied.fix: Resolve actual owner/repo/number via gh pr view and gh repo view before building API path

improvements_applied.issue: Validation gates ran against unchanged repo_dir instead of worker worktrees
improvements_applied.fix: Two-level gate architecture: run_focused_gates per-worker against worktree, run_all_gates post-merge against repo

improvements_applied.issue: ralph.sh was dead code — orchestrator never called it but SKILL.md claimed it did
improvements_applied.fix: Clarified ralph.sh as standalone debug runner; updated SKILL.md to accurately describe its role

improvements_applied.issue: cmd_report output was a fraction of what run_result_template.md specified
improvements_applied.fix: Added per-task breakdown, key step durations, validation summary, retrospective notes, initiative/agent metadata

improvements_applied.issue: test_focused_cmd in profile was never used despite being documented
improvements_applied.fix: run_focused_gates() now uses test_focused_cmd for per-worker validation

improvements_applied.issue: No checks that git, gh, codex, opencode, docker were installed
improvements_applied.fix: check_prerequisites() validates required tools on startup

improvements_applied.issue: SKILL.md structure had non-step sections breaking the Step 1-7 flow
improvements_applied.fix: Moved Run management and Agent backends to dedicated sections after Steps; added cross-agent context

improvements_applied.issue: Worker worktrees accumulated state from previous rounds
improvements_applied.fix: reset_worktree() cleans worktrees at the start of each round

eval_feedback.overall: All critical and high-priority issues have been resolved. The skill is structurally valid, functionally coherent, and the orchestrator code compiles cleanly.
